package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/contentaccess"
	lessonrelationuc "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lessonrelation"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// LessonRelationsHandler handles semantic links between lessons.
type LessonRelationsHandler struct {
	Validator *validator.Validate
	ReplaceUC lessonrelationuc.ReplaceLessonRelations
	ListUC    lessonrelationuc.ListLessonRelations
	DeleteUC  lessonrelationuc.DeleteLessonRelation
	Access    contentaccess.Service
}

type lessonRelationRequest struct {
	ID             string   `json:"id" validate:"omitempty,uuid"`
	SourceKey      string   `json:"source_key" validate:"required,max=255"`
	TargetLessonID string   `json:"target_lesson_id" validate:"required,uuid"`
	Relation       string   `json:"relation" validate:"required,oneof=implementation practice comparison reference prerequisite continuation see_also"`
	PrimaryStack   *string  `json:"primary_stack" validate:"omitempty,max=128"`
	Stacks         []string `json:"stacks" validate:"required,dive,required,max=128"`
	Concepts       []string `json:"concepts" validate:"required,min=1,dive,required,max=128"`
}

type replaceLessonRelationsRequest struct {
	Relations []lessonRelationRequest `json:"relations" validate:"required,dive"`
}

func (h LessonRelationsHandler) Replace(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req replaceLessonRelationsRequest
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	relations := make([]domain.LessonRelation, 0, len(req.Relations))
	for _, item := range req.Relations {
		relations = append(relations, domain.LessonRelation{
			ID:             item.ID,
			SourceKey:      item.SourceKey,
			TargetLessonID: item.TargetLessonID,
			Relation:       item.Relation,
			PrimaryStack:   item.PrimaryStack,
			Stacks:         item.Stacks,
			Concepts:       item.Concepts,
		})
	}
	if err := h.ReplaceUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "sourceLessonID"), relations); err != nil {
		writeLessonRelationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func (h LessonRelationsHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	sourceLessonID := chi.URLParam(r, "sourceLessonID")
	if !isPrivilegedRequest(r) {
		if err := h.Access.RequireLesson(r.Context(), sourceLessonID, ""); err != nil {
			writeContentAccessError(w, err)
			return
		}
	}
	relations, err := h.ListUC.Handle(r.Context(), sourceLessonID)
	if err != nil {
		writeLessonRelationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"lesson_relations": relations})
}

func (h LessonRelationsHandler) Delete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if err := h.DeleteUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "relationID")); err != nil {
		writeLessonRelationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func writeLessonRelationError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
	default:
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
	}
}
